product.description: Vechiul han din Boonsboro, Maryland, a supraviețuit războiului, și-a schimbat proprietarul de nenumărate ori și, potrivit zvonurilor, este bântuit de fantome. Acum frații Montgomery și excentrica lor mamă vor să îi redea farmecul de odinioară. Pentru arhitectul familiei, Beckett, munca este refugiul pentru o viață personală anostă. însă un proiect secret începe să îi ocupe tot mai mult gândurile: fata pe care o iubea în adolescență s-a întors în Boonsboro. Clare Brewster, acum mamă a trei copii, a revenit în orașul natal după ce soțul ei, militar, și-a pierdut viața în Irak. Proprietară a unei librării cochete, situate chiar peste drum de hotel, este prea ocupată ca să aibă timp de aventuri romantice. însă constată că viața îi poate oferi surprize extraordinare, căci băiatul care o adora discret în liceu s-a transformat într-un bărbat puternic și capabil, care ar putea să îi arate încă o dată drumul spre fericire.

# Treptele iubirii by Litera

## Discover the Romance of Boonsboro

This novel masterfully weaves together the enduring charm of an old haunted manor with the complicated affections of its inhabitants. Perfect for fans of classic American setting romances and emotionally rich fiction.

## Story Synopsis: A Homecoming Full of Surprises

The central plot revolves around a seemingly perfect life suddenly challenged by deep-seated desires and long-lost connections. The historic han in Boonsboro, Maryland, has withstood war and countless owners, leaving behind whispers of spectral activity. Now, the Montgomery siblings, alongside their eccentric mother, are determined to restore its former glory.

For the family architect, Beckett, professional work serves as a shield against a personally lackluster life. However, his focus is constantly drawn away by a secret project: the return of a girl he loved during his youth.

Clare Brewster returns to her hometown after her military husband's death in Iraq. Now a mother of three, she manages a quaint bookstore right across from a hotel. While she seems too busy for romance, life has other plans. Beckett realizes that this small town might hold extraordinary surprises. To make matters more complicated, the boy who once adored her quietly in high school has grown into a powerful and capable manâa man who might finally guide her toward true happiness.

## Why You Will Love This Novel

*Treptele iubirii* offers a compelling mix of elements: the gothic allure of an old haunted house, the warmth of small-town life, and the electric tension of second chances. It is a beautifully written journey about finding passion amid routine, proving that even after years passing, love can resurface in the most unexpected ways.
